doc: Back-trace through one tight tropical storm (omega 12, radius 0.05, no zonal flow) of a 25 x 25 patch covering three radii: the strongest winding the generator draws (omega 12 rad, nearly two turns at the core, with a steep shear around it). Tolerance rtol 4e-5, atol 4e-6: the loop is float64, so reversing the vortex order changes nothing at float32 (0 observed); a one-ulp nudge of the float32 directions moves the output by at most 1.8e-6 over the steps and time variants (0.37 of the default band; the shear of the flow stretches the nudge a few times), tolerance 10 times that. An integration done entirely in float32 (numpy, same loop) stays inside it (max 2.2e-6), so a float32 port can be checked against this case. Conventions of cloudgen.sphere read here: lonlat_to_dir(lon, lat) = (cos lat cos lon, cos lat sin lon, sin lat) with float64 numpy cos and sin (right-handed, z north, longitude grows east; a vortex center is that direction); normalize(v) = v / |v| (plain division, no epsilon: a zero vector gives NaN).

params.dtype_chain: p float32: the integration is float64 whatever the input dtype (q = p.astype(float64); velocity, normalize and the steps are float64); only the returned array is cast to float32.
